title: A theory of generalized Lamé curves
summary: We study the generalized Lam'e equation (GLE) on an elliptic curve $E$ with multiple regular singularities $\mathbf{p} = (p_i)_{i = 1}^r$ of weights $\mathbf{n} = (n_i)_{i = 1}^r$. By analyzing the locus admitting quasi-periodic solutions, we construct two fundamental algebraic curves: (i) The generalized Lam'e curve (GLC), $\mathcal{Y}_{\mathbf{n}, \mathbf{p}}$, which lies in an affine bundle over $\operatorname{Sym}^n E$ for total weight $n:=\sum n_i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ and parametrizes generalized Hermite--Halphen ansatz solutions.
